title: Conveyor System
text: Transport entities, 2 inputs, 5 outputs, {Blocked output behavior} sets Behavior when the output is blocked; {Conveyor length} sets the length of surface, {Conveyor speed} sets the speed of the conveyor surface, {Minimum distance between entities} sets the minimum physical separation, {Entity length source}, {Entity length value} sets the length of entities, {Entity length attribute name} sets the name of entity length, {Error if conveyor full} sets the conveyor behavior when the maximum number of entities, {Variable conveyor speed} sets the constant or variable conveyor speed, {Number of entities departed, d}, {Number of entities in block, n} sets the number of existing entities, {Pending entity in block, pe} sets the pending entities, {Number of entities extracted, ex} sets the number of entities extracted from this and {Conveyor speed, s} sets the speed of the conveyor for the duration. Values come from the instance.
